producer_report.summary: Replaced the sample requirements table with a full map of BRIEF.md: 124 rows with IDs, each marked covered (20), partial (58) or not covered (46). Added docs/design/strategy-view.md, which groups the rows into eight goals with counts and status lists. Added docs/design/roadmap.md, which has 13 ordered steps (RM-1 to RM-13) that between them hold all 104 partial and uncovered rows once, each with a "done when" test. The map links to both and has a Wording section (rows quote verbatim or paraphrase without quotation marks) and a "How to cite" section. Only BRIEF.md, which this change does not edit, is cited by line. Every other file, including the ones this change edits, is cited by heading, quote, or enforcement row number, so nothing can drift. Updated the CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry (no line cites) and added a README.md Map row. Markdown only; no code changed.

checks_run.note: The repository-policy tests, including the boundary scan and the check that docs/enforcement.md names real tests. The full cargo test, clippy and the whole-workspace test run were not run; only Markdown changed.
Shows only CHANGELOG.md, README.md and docs/design/*.md changed.

checks_run.command: Grep for the forbidden words and fragments over the five touched files

open_issues: Statuses are judgments from reading the docs and a few source files. I measured nothing and did not run a coverage check.
The strategy view's counts are hand-written, so they must be updated whenever a map status changes. RM-1 proposes generating them.
The roadmap order is a proposal for the user to correct.
BRIEF.md line cites are valid only while BRIEF.md is unchanged except by appended addenda. The map says so.
mistakes: I first wrote one row's requirement with quotation marks around a paraphrase (EN-1), which broke the Wording rule. I fixed it before finishing.
learnings: BRIEF.md's own text uses several banned words, so rows must paraphrase those lines and not quote them.
xtask's policy tests scan tracked prose for the boundary words, and one checks every test named in docs/enforcement.md exists. Doc-only changes still exercise them.
docs/enforcement.md rows are best cited by their M-number, which is stable.

The study capability's records support read/observed marks and could-not-run findings (crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs), but studies/ holds only the firstmate work-handling mechanism. There is no critique ledger, no site, no skills directory and no record of the active session.
docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and docs/design/native-pr-landing.md are both marked proposed, so the rows that depend on them are marked not covered.
desires: A script or xtask check that verifies map row IDs, status counts and BRIEF.md line cites against the tree.
A list of which BRIEF.md bullets map to which requirement IDs, so the rows need not be built by hand.
